profile.headline: Web Developer at Mount Sinai Health System
profile.geoLocationName: North Bergen, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Extensive knowledge of web design, web development, and graphic design. 
Specialize in Full Stack Web Technologies such as Front-End Design as well as Back-End Development. Server environments like Apache, NGINX, IIS, VPN. 

Advanced skills in SEO and CMS platforms such as WordPress (Hosted & MU); in addition to custom customizations of Themes, Child Themes, Templates, CPT, ACF, CSS, and PHP, MySQL, Updates, Plugins, Security, Back-Ups, Site Transfers, Debugging, Q&A and Maintenance. Version Control/Git, PM, Ticketing, Slack. 

Adaptive skills in markup and scripting languages like JavaScript, and libraries like jQuery. Experience with different frameworks such as Twitter Bootstrap & Foundation. Active learner of new web technologies.

positions.title: Web Developer / Admin
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities include WordPress Administration and Development, Front-End Web Development, Web Server Administration and Automated Testing. Other responsibilities also include working with internal stakeholders and lead developers, implementing and developing best practices such as commenting, documentation and bug tracking.
• Brought cutting-edge WordPress sites to life, creating interactive dynamic web pages and providing easy public access to critical information.
• Worked with experienced developers to contribute to the emergence of next-gen UI/UXP for content published by an enterprise web publishing platform.
• Worked closely with in-house content production team and off-shore QA team to help automate and run regression test scripts.
• Ensured best design principles are followed, working in tandem with fellow development team members.
• Produced clean and organized – well commented, using logical naming conventions.
• Documented processes and procedures.
• Created and maintain reusable code and components for use throughout and across multiple sites.
• Worked with source control system (Git) to carefully manage new pages/features.
• Managed tasks using JIRA. 
• Fully documented deployment and use of new features and enhancements using JIRA.
• Provided knowledgeable feedback on the technical feasibility of designs.
• Became adept at working with a market-leading CMS: OpenText.
• Maintained and administer basic Web server (Apache) configurations.

positions.title: Consultant / Freelancer (Web Development, Digital Marketing, Data Analyst, Project Management)
positions.description:
• Planned & successfully implemented electronic marketing campaigns such as, social media management (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google +, followers, likes, posts, friends, engagement, eWoM, branding, etc) & marketing (Google Adwords, Facebook Ads, Banner Ads, etc), local online marketing & advertising (Google Maps, online local directories ads such as Craigslist, etc.), affiliate marketing & referral mgmt, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Search Engine Marketing (SEM), Email Marketing, Blogging, Back linking, Branding (business card  & logo design, company colors), Website design (UI) & redesign (UX), mobile marketing, lead generation, video sharing (YouTube, Vimeo, etc), and more. 
• Provided technology-consulting expertise on business projects, including IT architecture and infrastructure planning & setup.
• Implement pre-sales activities, client demos, project estimates and proposals; identified and built relationships with key decision-makers requirement gathering, systems & site analysis, and interoperable workflow design for stability, growth and efficiency.
• Designed computer networks, relocate data networks, set-up temporary systems, wired remote facilities, custom programming, disaster planning, data recovery, communications, training, creating websites for electronic commerce and migration to wireless networks.
• Helped decide what equipment, environment and programs are best for the firm, taking into account cost, and system reliability.
• Performed routine maintenance, emergency troubleshooting, supporting and modifying existing network, Internet connectivity support, database analysis, configuration, and support, review of commercial software and hardware, work at home solutions (Work at Home Solutions & Remote Desktop Connections), Wi-Fi wireless, or hot-spot design and support, computer security systems design, implementation, and management, and more.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer responsibilities such as gathering user requirements, defining system functionality, writing code in various languages.
• Executed full software development life cycle (SDLC)
• Developed flowcharts, layouts, and documentation to identify requirements and solutions
• Wrote well-designed, testable code
• Produced specifications and determining operational feasibility
• Integrated software components into a fully functional software system
• Developed software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
• Documented and maintained software functionality
• Troubleshooted, debugged and upgraded existing systems
• Deploying programs and evaluating user feedback
• Complying with project plans and industry standards
• Ensuring software is updated with latest features

positions.title: Web Developer (Full-Stack, Front-End, Back-End), see recommendations below
positions.description:
Worked as a Full Stack Web Developer / Designer for many of the company's clients & site projects including (InflexionInteractive.com, Sabra.com, VisitHudson.org, Croda.com, DenTek.com, Repertorio.nyc, Good.com, Comar.com, eDesignInteractive.com, HunterdonHealthcare.org, ExhibitCompanyInc.com, Tisha Creative now inflexioninteractive.com/inflexion-tisha/, ShareMyLesson.com, America's Better Sandwich, NER, ...).

Some of the responsibilities included:
• Planning, Collaborating, Implementing
• Wireframes and Mockups to Web Design (PSD to HTML)
• HTML Email Designs (PSD to HTML)
• Develop Websites / Apps
• Responsive and Adaptive Designs and Cross Browser Compatibility
• Site Q&A, PageSpeed Insights, SEO, and Best standards
• Website Security, Back-Ups, Migrations, SQL Database Maintenance, CMS Updates & Upgrades
• Custom Scripting and Element Design (plugins, add-ons, scripts, analytics, sharing, social media, printing, widgets, third party apps, and APIs).

Skills used included: Website Design and Development, Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite, Office, Google Apps, Screen Sharing, Remote Control, Content Management, Custom CMS Development, Custom Post Types and Advanced Custom Fields, WordPress, Drupal, CMS Installation, Photoshop to HTML, HTML Email, HTML5, CSS3, Scripting, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, PHP, APIs, Programming, Development, Windows Servers (IIS), Apache Servers, NGINX, Windows OS, Mac OSX, WAMP, LAMP or MAMP STACK, Terminal, IDEs, SublimeText, Atom, SQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Git & Version Control, GitHub, BitBucket, Server Maintenance, OOP, MVC, Basecamp, Mavenlink, Jira, Quality Assurance, Analytics, Webmaster Tools, SEO, PageSpeed Insights, Site Migration, Problem Solving, Active Listening, Meetings, Time Management, Team Player, Record Keeping/Tracking.

positions.title: Computer Instructor
positions.description:
• Responsible for teaching computer skills for community members in the Passaic, NJ area.
• Conducted computer-related resume writing, career development, and motivation.
• Prepared reports of student progress for state funded program officials.
• Repaired, upgraded, and maintained/managed computers in the classroom lab.
• Instructed in a variety of computer software applications including basic computer skills.
• Developed individualized-skills-plan of instructions for each student.
• Managed all aspects of the computer classroom, such as, physical setup environment, computer security measures, student discipline and attendance, benefits-time-sheets submission, computer logs, and reports.
• Volunteered as a Network Administrator / IT Support & Project Management.

positions.title: Sales Counselor
positions.description:
• Sold and delivered Honda line of new and pre-owned vehicles and products.
• Handled customer service and negotiations during the purchase contract.

positions.title: Records Retention Management and Management Consultant (Pitney Bowes Management Svcs)
positions.description:
• Manager of the Records Department and coordinator for company supplies.
• Implemented computer systems and communication methods for managing, delivering, and maintaining documents and information.
• Security work implementation favoring the protection of the company's mailroom delivery via a security scanner machine validating incoming important packages to the company.
• Attended meetings with COO, Immediate department manager, and team leader for quotas/reports, operations, and planning reviews.
• Responsible for the effective and appropriate supply and disposal the organization's records.

positions.title: Assistant Sales Manager & Manager in Training
positions.description:
• Assistant Manager, Manager in Training (MIT) and Ten-Ten-Team member.
• Aided in the training of Staff, team leadership, retail administration and assistance, public relations with companies such as Verizon Wireless, and Sprint PCS, and other top retailers, & Key Holder.

positions.description:
Performed office management and  coordinated office support services.
Assisted owner in office tasks such as filing and record keeping, faxing, data entry, manage dot-matrix printers, updated computers,  directed mailroom & maintenance, wrote business letters, created document templates and desktop publishing, answered phone calls and set up appointments.
